messages:
Gina Morales: Heads-up — Cobalt Retail asked for a hard EOW target for Private deployment and KMS integration. They called this morning, sounded urgent. Want a firm go-live date by end of quarter.

Ajay Patel: Yikes. Which features are must-have vs nice-to-have? We need to push back on scope if the date is fixed.

Gina Morales: Sales says "must-have": VPC Private control plane, customer KMS + HSM key wrap, RBAC mapping to their IdP, and token-level billing export. "Nice-to-have": per-customer quantization tuning and custom prompt templates.

Marta Chen: For engineering: the KMS/HSM integration is non-trivial — depends on HSM vendor. Do we have an approved adapter?

Kevin Liu: Not yet. We have an internal KMS adapter prototype but it doesn't support the PKCS#11 variants some banks use. Cobalt uses Thales nShield (PKCS#11 + remote attestation). That needs a small integration sprint.

Ajay Patel: Can we de-scope per-customer quantization tuning to hit the date? That seems like the quickest path. Keep RBAC + KMS + export as MVP.

Marta Chen: Agree. Also need to confirm expected throughput for Dedicated GPU pools. If they want double current capacity, that impacts infra provisioning lead time.

Gina Morales: Cobalt expects 10k realtime tokens/sec initially; they clarified burst to 20k. They want SLA 99.9 for inference latency.

Kevin Liu: 20k bursts means we need capacity reservations and autoscaling warm-up. Provisioning GPUs takes ~3 weeks minimum in Dedicated model + validation.

Ajay Patel: Timeline math: KMS HSM adapter (2 weeks), RBAC mapping + IdP config (1 week), billing export (2-3 days), infra provisioning (3 weeks), integration testing (1 week). Realistic earliest end-to-end is ~5-6 weeks if we parallelize.

Marta Chen: We can parallelize KMS adapter and infra work, but we need security signoff in between. Security team — Elaine, any concerns on accepting a proto adapter for Thales?

Elaine - Security Bot: @Marta Chen flagged for review. Requirements: FIPS compliance proof, attestation flow validation, and key handling docs. ETA for review: 4 business days after adapter spec received.

Gina Morales: Sales pushed for 2024-07-05 go-live. Is that feasible?

Kevin Liu: With current staffing, 2024-07-05 is tight. If we start tomorrow and no blockers, maybe a limited Beta (cobalt-internal) by 2024-07-05 excluding per-customer quant tuning. GA would slip.

Ajay Patel: Proposal: Commit to Beta on 2024-07-05 with Beta SLA (best-effort, 99.5 target) and GA on 2024-08-16 with full 99.9 SLA. Document the delta in a Commitment Note for the account.

Gina Morales: Cobalt likely accepts staged rollout, but they want a firm GA date in writing. Sales wants a migration window and rollback plan too.

Marta Chen: I'll draft a minimal rollback runbook (network route toggle + model variant fallback). Also propose a canary window: 48 hours with detailed telemetry feed to their ops team.

Kevin Liu: For the rollout policy, we can use this config snippet and share it:

```
rollout:
  phase1: beta-accounts: [cobalt-dev]
    traffic: 5%
    duration: 48h
  phase2: gradual: traffic: 50% duration: 72h
  phase3: full: traffic: 100% duration: 24h
fallback:
  model_variant: small-quantized
  fallback_region: us-west-2
```

Keep per-customer quant tuning out of Beta.

Ajay Patel: Need to add cost/commit terms for Dedicated. Finance: do we have a short-term reserved capacity SKU they can sign for 6 weeks?

Gina Morales: Sales will draft an amendment. They agreed to a 6-week reserve for capacity testing.

Elaine - Security Bot: Reminder: KMS adapter spec must include key usage policies, no-export proofs, and integration test vectors. Send to security@redwood for review.

Gina Morales: Action items: 1) Marta to publish KMS adapter spec by EOD tomorrow. 2) Kevin to open infra provisioning request (3-week lead) today. 3) Ajay to prepare Commitment Note with Beta/GA dates and described deltas. 4) DevEx to prep SDK snippet for RBAC and token export. 5) Sales to get capacity amendment signed.

Marta Chen: Ack — will post spec: includes PKCS#11 test harness and attestation checklist.

Kevin Liu: Infra request filed: ticket #INF-4827, provisioning start 2024-06-10.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline status: infra-provisioning job queued for ticket INF-4827.

Ajay Patel: I'll circulate a first draft Commitment Note by EOD. Quick Q — do we call the 2024-07-05 thing "Beta" in the legal amendment or call it "Initial Launch"? Legal prefers less ambiguous language.

Gina Morales: Use "Initial Beta Launch" and specify acceptance criteria. Legal will add an exhibit for scope.

Elaine - Security Bot: Security review hold: adapter spec receipt required to start compliance review.

Gina Morales: Thanks all. I'll update Cobalt with the staged plan: Beta 2024-07-05 (limited scope, Beta SLA), GA 2024-08-16 (full features + SLA 99.9). Will note per-customer quant tuning as separate project. :thumbsup:

Marta Chen: Adding follow-up thread for spec comments once posted. :eyes:
